_readme: S650. A constructed stand-in for four pages of Cosumnes River's hand-filed 2026-27 catalog PDF (653 pages; the session container cannot fetch the copy), for the pdf_pages pin (kb/_program_requirements_college.py pdf_pinned_heading). Verbatim: each own page's opening words, as the filed capture of 2026-10-17 opened on them (kb/program_requirements_college/cosumnes_river/capture.json pdf.picks for 30566 and 33072), and the Cal-GETC sentences the reconcile entry's evidence quotes from run 43519918667. Constructed: the rest of each page, the course lines, and the two decoys in the shape run 43521338550's review describes (30566 to p.467, a page naming 'History, Psychology or Sociology AA-T' as another degree; 33072 to p.94, the Cal-GETC pattern page). The decoys are built so the heading picker takes them; they show the pin overrides a picker that prefers another page, never why the real picker did.

Associate in Arts in History for Transfer Degree (AA-T)
The Associate in Arts in History for Transfer Degree (AA-T) is designed to provide a seamless transfer pathway for students interested in pursuing a History degree in the California State University (CSU) system.
Students must complete a total of 60 transferable semester units with a minimum 2.0 GPA, to include the California General Education Transfer Curriculum (Cal-GETC) pattern
